# [Fix] [NVIDIA] deepseek-v4.1: Fix prefill CP (interleave) crashes on SM90/SM100/SM120

## Motivation

Prefill context parallelism (`--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave`) for DeepSeek V4.1 fails to start or crashes on SM90, SM100 and SM120. This PR fixes those runtime bugs and adds no performance changes.

| # | Error | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Interleave CP gather received an unexpected local token count` on the first prefill | CP + `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay` + DSPARK |
| 2 | `shape '[192, 4096]' is invalid ...` during decode CUDA graph capture | SM90 + `--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` + dense FP8 not on DeepGEMM (e.g. `--fp8-gemm-backend triton`) |
| 3 | `b_descale shape mismatch for swizzled layout` at startup | Blackwell (FlashInfer MXFP8 dense GEMM) + `--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` |
| 4 | `the torch indexer needs the batch's rows` on prefill | SM90 (torch prefill indexer) + CP |

## Modifications

- `models/deepseek_v4.py` (bug 1): under CP with DSPARK, scatter the bounded-replay tail rows (hidden states, `pre_hc_head`, DSpark aux) back into the rank's extend rows before `cp_gather_after_forward`. Rows outside the tail are zero-filled.
- `layers/cp/cp_decode_attn_tp.py`:
  - Bug 2: also slice the Hopper BF16 weight cache `_block_fp8_bf16_weight`.
  - Bug 3: slice `weight_scale_inv_swizzled` along whole 128x4 SF tiles.
  - Linears without these attributes are sliced as before, so other models' CP decode attention TP is unchanged.
- `layers/attention/deepseek_v4_backend.py` (bug 4): pass the rank-local `req_rows` (`repeat_interleave(req_pool_indices, q_lens_cpu)`) to the indexer instead of `None`.
- `dsv4/v41_indexer/types.py`: comment update only.
- New unit tests: `test/registered/unit/cp/test_cp_decode_attn_tp_unit.py` and `test_dsv4_prefill_cp_rows_unit.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

gsm8k (5-shot, 400 questions), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DSPARK + bounded replay, radix cache on:

| Hardware | Non-CP | CP |
|---|---|---|
| RTX 6000D (SM120, tp8) | 0.900 | 0.895 |
| GB200 (SM100, tp4) | 0.907 | 0.920 |
| H20 (SM90, tp8, marlin) | 0.910 | 0.897 |
| H20 (SM90, tp8, flashinfer_mxfp4) | 0.882 | 0.897 |
| H20 (SM90, tp8, humming) | 0.902 | 0.900 |

DSpark accept length is within 0.14 of non-CP on every setup.

Unit tests:
- The new tests pass (28 passed). Each one fails when its fix is reverted.
- Existing CP / DSV4 unit tests: 70 passed both before and after this change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This PR has no performance changes. For reference, CP vs non-CP prefill input throughput on the same fixed code (chunk 16384):

| Hardware | Non-CP (tok/s) | CP (tok/s) |
|---|---|---|
| RTX 6000D (SM120) TP8 EP8| 8065 | 9044 (+12%) |
| GB200 (SM100) TP4 EP4| 77766 | 113769 (+46%) |
| H20 (SM90, flashinfer_mxfp4) TP8 EP8| 13400 | 21056 (+57%) |
| H20 (SM90, marlin) TP8 EP8| 13109 | 21312 (+63%) |
| H20 (SM90, humming) TP8 EP8 | 15945 | 28391 (+78%) |



in SM120, please set SGLANG_SM120_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=triton


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).

   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

+"""CPU checks for CP decode attention TP: which linear attributes are sliced, the
+128x4-swizzled MXFP8 scale, and the Hopper BF16 weight cache."""
+
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.cp_decode_attn_tp import CpDecodeAttnTpContext
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _ctx(rank: int, size: int) -> CpDecodeAttnTpContext:
+    ctx = CpDecodeAttnTpContext.__new__(CpDecodeAttnTpContext)
+    ctx.decode_tp_rank = rank
+    ctx.decode_tp_size = size
+    ctx.use_decode_attn_tp = False
+    ctx._slice_cache = {}
+    return ctx
+
+
+def _linear(cls, n: int, k: int):
+    """A linear with the attributes decode attention TP reads, no process group."""
+    linear = cls.__new__(cls)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(linear)
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        torch.randn(n, k).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    linear.weight_scale_inv = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        torch.rand(n // 32, k // 32), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    linear.input_size_per_partition = k
+    linear.output_size_per_partition = n
+    linear.use_decode_attn_tp = False
+    return linear
+
+
+def _swizzle_ref(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FlashInfer block_scale_interleave layout: 128x4 tiles, 32x4x4 inside each."""
+    rows, cols = scale.shape
+    pr, pc = -(-rows // 128) * 128, -(-cols // 4) * 4
+    padded = scale.new_zeros(pr, pc)
+    padded[:rows, :cols] = scale
+    tiles = padded.reshape(pr // 128, 4, 32, pc // 4, 4).permute(0, 3, 2, 1, 4)
+    return tiles.reshape(-1).contiguous()
+
+
+def _narrow(t: torch.Tensor, dim: int, rank: int, size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    chunk = t.shape[dim] // size
+    return t.narrow(dim, rank * chunk, chunk)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _enter(ctx: CpDecodeAttnTpContext, modules):
+    def force_decode(forward_batch):
+        ctx.use_decode_attn_tp = True
+
+    with patch.object(ctx, "set_decode_attn_tp", side_effect=force_decode):
+        with ctx.maybe_use_decode_attn_tp(SimpleNamespace(), modules):
+            yield
+
+
+def _same(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return a.data_ptr() == b.data_ptr() and a.shape == b.shape
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls", [ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear])
+def test_plain_linear_slices_weight_and_scale_only(cls):
+    # The FP8 linear every CP model uses: no derived caches, no swizzled scale.
+    # Behaves the same before and after the derived-copy slicing was added.
+    ctx = _ctx(rank=1, size=4)
+    linear = _linear(cls, 256, 512)
+    dim = 1 if cls is RowParallelLinear else 0
+    attrs = ctx._get_linear_attrs(linear)
+    assert [(a[1], a[2]) for a in attrs] == [
+        ("weight", dim),

+"""CPU checks for DeepSeek V4 prefill CP interleave rows: the request of each of a
+rank's local rows given to the indexer, and the bounded-replay tail put back into
+the rank's extend rows."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import (
+    DeepseekV4AttnBackend,
+    LateLayerTail,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.cp.interleave import (
+    InterleaveCPStrategy,
+    interleave_rows_per_request,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4 import _cp_tail_to_extend_rows
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _ExtendMode:
+    def is_idle(self):
+        return False
+
+    def is_decode(self):
+        return False
+
+    def is_target_verify(self):
+        return False
+
+    def is_extend(self):
+        return True
+
+
+def _local_rows_request(extend_lens, req_pool_indices, rank, cp_size):
+    """The request of each row the interleave shard gives this rank."""
+    global_req = torch.repeat_interleave(
+        req_pool_indices, torch.tensor(extend_lens, dtype=torch.int64)
+    )
+    with get_parallel().override(attn_cp_rank=rank, attn_cp_size=cp_size):
+        return InterleaveCPStrategy(cp_size=cp_size)._interleave_shard(global_req)
+
+
+def _run_indexer_cp(extend_lens, req_pool_indices, rank, cp_size, tail=None):
+    total = sum(extend_lens)
+    counts = interleave_rows_per_request(extend_lens, rank, cp_size)
+    num_local = sum(counts)
+    pad = 3  # the rank's padding rows come after its real rows
+    backend = DeepseekV4AttnBackend.__new__(DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
+    backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(late_layer_tail=tail)
+    backend._low_ratio_index_topk = MagicMock()
+    forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=_ExtendMode(),
+        attn_cp_metadata=SimpleNamespace(total_seq_lens=total),
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=extend_lens,
+        extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor(extend_lens),
+        req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+        positions=torch.arange(total),
+    )
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(compressor=None, indexer=object())
+    with get_parallel().override(attn_cp_rank=rank, attn_cp_size=cp_size):
+        backend._forward_low_ratio_sources_cp(
+            layer=layer,
+            x=torch.zeros(num_local + pad, 8),
+            q_lora=torch.zeros(num_local + pad, 4),
+            positions=torch.arange(num_local + pad),
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            run_compressor=False,
+            run_indexer=True,
+        )
+    backend._low_ratio_index_topk.assert_called_once()
+    args, kwargs = backend._low_ratio_index_topk.call_args
+    return args, kwargs, counts
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_size", [2, 4, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("extend_lens", [[10], [7, 1, 13], [3, 16, 2, 9]])
+def test_indexer_rows_name_their_request(cp_size, extend_lens):
+    req_pool_indices = torch.arange(len(extend_lens), dtype=torch.int64) * 5 + 2
+    for rank in range(cp_size):
+        args, kwargs, counts = _run_indexer_cp(
+            extend_lens, req_pool_indices, rank, cp_size
+        )
+        _, x, q_lora, req, pos, _ = args
+        num_local = sum(counts)
+        assert x.shape[0] == q_lora.shape[0] == pos.shape[0] == num_local
+        assert kwargs["rows_per_request"] == counts
+        assert req.dtype == torch.int64
+        assert torch.equal(
+            req, _local_rows_request(extend_lens, req_pool_indices, rank, cp_size)
+        )
+
+
+def test_indexer_rows_follow_the_tail_lengths():
+    # Under bounded replay the rank's rows are its tail rows, tail.local_lens_cpu each.
+    req_pool_indices = torch.tensor([4, 9, 1], dtype=torch.int64)
+    tail = SimpleNamespace(
+        local_lens_cpu=[2, 0, 3],
+        req_global=torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.int64),
+        pos_global=torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.int64),
+    )
+    backend = DeepseekV4AttnBackend.__new__(DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
+    backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(late_layer_tail=tail)
+    backend._low_ratio_index_topk = MagicMock()
+    forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=_ExtendMode(),
+        attn_cp_metadata=SimpleNamespace(total_seq_lens=40),
+        req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+    )
+    with get_parallel().override(attn_cp_rank=1, attn_cp_size=4):
+        backend._forward_low_ratio_sources_cp(
+            layer=SimpleNamespace(compressor=None, indexer=object()),
+            x=torch.zeros(6, 8),
+            q_lora=torch.zeros(6, 4),
+            positions=torch.arange(6),
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            run_compressor=False,
+            run_indexer=True,
+        )
+    args, kwargs = backend._low_ratio_index_topk.call_args
+    assert torch.equal(args[3], torch.tensor([4, 4, 1, 1, 1]))
+    assert kwargs["rows_per_request"] == [2, 0, 3]
+
+
+def _tail(token_indices, pad_rows):
+    n = len(token_indices)
+    return LateLayerTail(
+        token_indices=torch.tensor(token_indices, dtype=torch.int64),
+        positions=torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.int64),
+        extend_seq_lens=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64),
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=[n],
+        swa_out_cache_loc=torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.int64),
+        pad_rows=pad_rows,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(4,), (4, 3)])
+def test_cp_tail_rows_return_to_extend_rows(shape):
+    # Local extend of 9 rows; the tail is rows 2, 3 (request 0) and 7, 8 (request 1),
+    # followed by 2 padding rows.
+    tail = _tail([2, 3, 7, 8], pad_rows=2)
+    rows = torch.arange(1, 6 * torch.Size(shape[1:]).numel() + 1, dtype=torch.float32)
+    rows = rows.reshape(6, *shape[1:]).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    full = _cp_tail_to_extend_rows(tail=tail, rows=rows, num_tokens=9)
+    assert full.shape == (9, *shape[1:])
+    assert full.dtype == rows.dtype
+    assert torch.equal(full[tail.token_indices], rows[:4])
+    outside = torch.tensor([0, 1, 4, 5, 6])
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(full[outside]) == 0
+
+
+def test_cp_tail_rows_are_zero_not_uninitialized():
+    tail = _tail([5], pad_rows=0)
+    rows = torch.full((1, 2), float("nan"))
+    full = _cp_tail_to_extend_rows(tail=tail, rows=rows, num_tokens=6)
+    assert torch.isnan(full[5]).all()
+    assert torch.equal(full[:5], torch.zeros(5, 2))
